confirmation: A survey author confirmed that both co-authors personally checked the cited source passages and approved their submitted judgments.
reviewer_labels: Reviewer A and B replace personal file identifiers. Empty reviewer-ID, completion-date, and independence fields remain empty in the copied forms. The confirmation date is not an inferred review-completion date.
scope: The 36 supplied setting-pair information-flow and empirical-relationship judgments, covering 28 settings from 18 papers.
limits: The confirmation does not establish independent first-pass annotation, complete paired subtype judgments, validation of all 89 endpoint assignments, or reproduction of SQL/model experiments. Original forms and their provenance notes are retained unchanged.
agreement_scope: Descriptive agreement on the submitted forms, which include follow-up corrections. Independent pre-discussion reliability is not established.
subtype_policy: Retain both forms' subtype entries verbatim, including blanks. Empirical evidence types above are a source-based synthesis of the empirical rationales, not a mechanical conjunction of E=P and a subtype P. R06 per-meaning P describes a training schema-check mechanism. No paired numerical per-meaning absence claim is reported.
resolution_authority: Source-based synthesis accepted by the survey author, not an additional unanimous reviewer vote.
